_about: Racks Tiffany REPLACED in a set's final list (config/tile-racks-picks.json final_lists). Gate [15] fails if the old rack is still in that set's D.lt (her tile-rack list) or in any of its m (Tiffany's-match) rack lists, or if the new rack is missing from D.lt. D.uni (universal racks for every set) is not checked: the old rack may stay universal. Add an entry whenever she swaps a rack in final_lists.

papaya-spritz.why: Tiffany's Papaya Spritz rack swap (final_lists papaya-spritz, commit 306d7f5); QA found Oak still in D.lt with a Tiffany's-match badge.
